<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "http://127.0.0.1/nonexistent.dtd">
  %ext;
]>
<root xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <child>Test Entity Expansion</child>
  <xi:include href="nonexistent.xml" parse="xml">
    <xi:fallback>
      <child>Fallback Content</child>
    </xi:fallback>
  </xi:include>
</root>

<!DOCTYPE test [
  <!ELEMENT test ANY>
  <!ENTITY % int "internal entity">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY resolved '%int;'>">
  %param;
]>
<test attr="value">
  &resolved;
  <![CDATA[Unparsed CDATA section with special chars: <>&'"]]></CDATA>
  <?processing-instruction target="value"?>
  <!-- Comment inside document body -->
</test>

    <deep>
      <deeper>
        <deepest>Deeply nested elements to stress stack limits and parsing depth bounds.</deepest>
      </deeper>
    </deep>
  </ns2:element>
</root>
